title: PermissionRuleImportResult
description: `POST /permission-rules/import`: what applying an accepted lot of an import file actually created (plan 15, B-18, D-17). Revalidated against this installation right before writing — an item accepted at preview that would now be refused fails the whole call, nothing written.

existing.description: Already active before this call — the grant routine's own idempotency, not a second write.

rules.description: Every accepted item's rule, in the order it was accepted.
